in_sanskrit.name: नाविया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is new, fresh, or young. It can also mean 'one who brings something new'. In Sanskrit literature, Naaviya is also used as a feminine form of the word 'Naava' which means 'ship'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'nav' meaning 'new'.

in_hindi.name: नाविया
in_hindi.long_meaning: Naavya in Hindi can mean 'new', 'tool', or 'foundation'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'nav' meaning 'new'. This name is also used in Hindi literature and culture.

in_tamil.name: நாவியா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Naavya in Tamil can mean 'newborn' or 'young one'. It is derived from the Tamil root 'na' meaning 'new' and 'vi' meaning 'born'. This name is used in Tamil literature and culture.

in_telugu.name: నావీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Naavya in Telugu can mean 'new' or 'goddess of wealth'. It is derived from the Telugu root 'na' meaning 'new'. This name is used in Telugu literature and culture.

in_marathi.name: Naavya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Naavya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Naavya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nav', meaning 'new'. In Hindu mythology, Naavya refers to the new beginning or fresh start. This name carries the blessings of a new life or a new journey.
